verdict.rationale: ROS 2 is software you install and run on your own machines. The official Ubuntu deb install docs offer Desktop and ROS-Base (bare-bones) variants and a verification step, the public GitHub repo hosts the code, and community users confirm it is open source. One user notes the Open Robotics-supplied debs aren't suitable for most product deployments, which is a packaging caveat rather than a barrier to self-hosting. Missing for 10: explicit first-party license statement, documented build-from-source or non-Ubuntu install paths, and production-grade deployment packaging guidance.
